mintAuthority.summary: USYC has materially unbounded native issuer issuance on Ethereum and Solana: Ethereum max-allowance minters and immediate token-owner upgrade control, plus Solana program-controlled mint and upgrade surfaces. BSC USYC is an issuer-operated Cross Chain Teller representation sourced from Ethereum; its bridge minter, Entitlements/admin, shared allowance, and token upgrade controls are scored under bridgeRouteRisk, not canonical Mint Authority.

controls.label: USYC Ethereum FundAdmin and max-allowance minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095806, minterAllowance returned uint256.max and eth_getCode returned 0x for this account. RolesAuthority doesUserHaveRole(account,255) and canCall(account,USYC,setMinterAllowance) both returned true. This reconfirms the native FundAdmin and unbounded minter capabilities recorded at block 25526129. Its BSC route capability is separately reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: USYC Ethereum RolesAuthority owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, this zero-code EOA owned RolesAuthority 0x902d...808c. It could immediately grant or revoke the FundAdmin role and modify authority capability assignments, enabling a new unbounded native minter.

controls.label: USYC Ethereum token upgrade owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, this zero-code EOA was token owner. The UUPS implementation's _authorizeUpgrade is onlyOwner, so the account could replace native mint logic immediately with no on-chain delay. The current implementation still requires minterAllowance and does not give the owner a direct mint path by itself.

review.evidence: The 2026-10-01 Ethereum block 26095806 read reconfirmed uint256.max allowances for all six historical native minters, the FundAdmin's role and setMinterAllowance permission, token owner 0x13ff...dd6, RolesAuthority owner 0x8fb0...2fc0, and implementation 0xbf0f...eb92. At finalized Solana slot 452213698, the mint/freeze authority remained the documented Permissions-program account and ProgramData DwbK...s7M was successfully read with upgrade authority P3S7...vb7B, resolving the earlier account-fetch uncertainty. The authority accounts remain non-executable/System Program-owned on Solana and zero-code on Ethereum; off-chain signer custody remains unverified. Historical issuance and upgrade exposure is retained. BSC representation controls remain separate and have not been inferred from Ethereum state.
